Dilworth-Kutzarova-Stankov arXiv:2203.08229 proves L2->L1>=9/8 and D2->L1>=5/4 via negative-type PP/NN weights (72 vs 64c); verified via ar5iv full text that Remark 14 transfers only to (ell2,||.||_2^2) snowflake d<=||.||^2<=c d, not standard bi-Lipschitz distortion, so neither records nor mechanically implies L_k->ell2 D^2>=1+k/2 fork headline. Mendel-Naor 0803.1697 is qualitative power-type iff Markov p-convex with no level-k Laakso fork datum. Baudier-Gartland umbel/fork is local theory with no Laakso growth threshold. Baudier et al. 1612.01984 is countably-branching diamonds into asymptotically midpoint-UC, not finite Laakso into power-type-2 with constants. Li 1404.6751 embeds Laakso G_n into Heisenberg with C n^{1/4}sqrt(log n) and Heisenberg-to-Markov-p bounds, different family/exponent. Live arXiv searches replayed: 'Laakso graphs embedding' (7 hits, only Dilworth/Li relevant), 'Laakso uniformly convex distortion' (0), 'diamond Hilbert sqrt' (0), 'fork convexity distortion' (0), 'diamond uniformly convex' (1 hit Baudier-diamonds), 'Markov Laakso' (1 hit Li), 'Laakso Hilbert' (3 hits, SRA/Heisenberg/doubling, no distortion threshold), 'diamond embedding Hilbert' (1 hit Ostrovskii superreflexivity survey, qualitative). No source records explicit D^2>=1+k/2 for L_k->ell2 via one fork inequality plus induction, nor the k^{1/p-1/2} constant c=2^{-1/2}. Not mechanically implied by O(.) theorems.
